name: Redemption Or Salvation
overview: Scripture reveals that redemption and salvation are gifts of God's grace accessed through faith in Jesus Christ, who is the only way to the Father and the source of eternal life. Believing in Him grants everlasting life and justification, as sins are blotted out through repentance and conversion. Those united with Christ are no longer under condemnation but walk according to the Spirit, experiencing the fullness of God's saving work.
